content.short: Fly.trade swaps assets between chains without requiring a separate bridging step.
content.description: Fly.trade executes cross-chain swaps as a single action, so a user moves from an asset on one network to an asset on another without separately bridging and then trading. Monad's documentation lists it among the chain's DEX aggregators. Collapsing bridge-then-swap into one flow removes the step where users most often end up stranded holding a wrapped asset they did not want.
content.meta: Fly.trade performs cross-chain swaps in one step, without a separate bridging transaction.
